Diagnosis.submission: The frontend deployment in the astronomy-shop namespace has an incorrect DNS configuration: dnsPolicy is set to "None" and dnsConfig.nameservers is set to ["8.8.8.8"] (Google public DNS) instead of the default "ClusterFirst" policy. This causes the frontend pod to use an external DNS resolver that cannot resolve internal Kubernetes service names (such as ad, product-catalog, cart, recommendation, etc.), resulting in "Name resolution failed" errors for all gRPC service-to-service calls. The fix is to remove the dnsPolicy and dnsConfig overrides from the frontend deployment so it uses the default ClusterFirst DNS policy.
